rulers.title: Head of State and Prime Minister (Duce)

ledger.x: 23 September 1943: Mussolini proclaims the Italian Social Republic in German-held northern Italy.
September 1943: Germany holds the RSI as a client state.
4 June 1944: Rome falls to the Allies.
August 1944: the Allies reach the Gothic Line.
25 August 1944: Operation Olive attacks the Gothic Line, which 'ran from the coast some 50 kilometres (30 miles) north of Pisa' to 'just south of Rimini'.
9-21 April 1945: the Allied spring offensive breaks the line.
29 April - 2 May 1945: German forces in Italy surrender.
25 April 1945: the Italian Social Republic ends.

wars.name: Italian campaign (World War II)
wars.outcome: The Allies take Rome (4 June 1944), Ancona (18 July) and Florence (August), stall at the Gothic Line through the winter, and break through from 9 April 1945; German forces in Italy surrender on 29 April, effective 2 May 1945.
